deleteCustomerHelp: This permanently deletes the customer and all of its endpoints.
customerHelp: Edit the customer name, listener IP and port. Names must be unique; existing endpoints are preserved.
noCustomersHelp: Configure endpoints, then start the server for your clients.
stopToEdit: Stop the server before changing the customer or listener.
manualStart: Manual start · Stops when the window closes
endpointHelp: Matches method and path exactly; query parameters are ignored.
responseHint: Up to 1 MiB. HEAD, 204 and 304 responses have no body.
noEndpointsHelp: Add an endpoint and choose the JSON or text to return.
deleteEndpointHelp: Deleting this endpoint immediately stops matching new requests.
unsavedHelp: Switching will discard unsaved endpoint or listener changes.
noLogs: Requests and server events will appear here
notificationHelp: Important events from this session, up to 100 entries.
appearanceHelp: Choose your theme and language. Preferences are saved on this device.
languageHelp: Changes the interface and notifications, not customer or endpoint content.
collapseHelp: Keep icons and make more room for content.
resetHelp: Reset theme and sidebar; keep language and simulator configurations.
FORBIDDEN: This page cannot perform this action.
INVALID_INPUT: Check the name, IP, port and endpoint configuration.
INVALID_JSON: The response body is not valid JSON.
INVALID_PATH: Use a path starting with /, without spaces, query or fragment. URL-encode non-ASCII text.
DUPLICATE_ROUTE: The method and path must be unique within a customer.
SAVE_FAILED: Save failed. Check disk space and file permissions, then retry.
READ_FAILED: Unable to read configuration. Using defaults without overwriting the file.
RECOVERED: Corrupt configuration was backed up; defaults were restored.
RECOVERY_FAILED: Configuration could not be recovered. The original file is preserved and saving is disabled.
NEWER_VERSION: Configuration is from a newer version. Using defaults without overwriting it.
CONNECTION_FAILED: Unable to connect to the local service. Reload to retry.
CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND: Customer not found. Select another customer.
ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND: Endpoint not found. Select another endpoint.
CLOSING: The server is shutting down. Please wait.
PORT_IN_USE: The port is in use. Choose another port and retry.
ADDRESS_UNAVAILABLE: Cannot bind this IP. Use an address assigned to this device.
BIND_DENIED: Permission denied for this port. Choose another port.
START_FAILED: Server failed to start. Check the listener configuration.
SERVER_ERROR: The server encountered an error and stopped listening.
updateEntryHelp: Check for new versions, read release notes, and choose the next action.
updateDemoHelp: GitHub is not connected. This demo simulates versions and progress without network access, file downloads or installation.
updateDemoComplete: Demo complete. No files were downloaded. Real installation requires a configured GitHub release source.
updateInstallHelp: This stops the simulator, flushes saved configuration and quits the app. Save any drafts before continuing.
UPDATE_PACKAGED_ONLY: Real updates are available only in the packaged application.
UPDATE_BUSY: An update operation is in progress.
UPDATE_ALREADY_DOWNLOADED: An update is already downloaded. Install it or restart before checking again.
UPDATE_CHECK_FIRST: Check for an available update first.
UPDATE_DEMO_ONLY: The local demo cannot install updates.
UPDATE_CONNECTION_FAILED: Unable to reach the app update service. Retry.
UPDATE_CHECK_FAILED: Unable to check for updates. Check the network, GitHub repository and release metadata.
UPDATE_DOWNLOAD_FAILED: Download or verification failed. Check for updates and retry.
UPDATE_INSTALL_FAILED: Installation failed. Check app signing and installation permissions.
UPDATE_MANUAL_ONLY: This macOS build is unsigned. Download the new version from GitHub and replace it manually.
copyCustomerHelp: Copy listener settings and all endpoints, including enabled states. You can edit the IP and port. Enter a different customer name.
DUPLICATE_CUSTOMER_NAME: This customer name already exists. Use another name (ignoring surrounding spaces and letter case).
endpointCardsHelp: Drag a handle to reorder, or focus it and use arrow keys.
endpointDialogHelp: Edit the endpoint and save to apply. Unsaved changes are protected when closing.
notificationPositionHelp: Only important events and errors show notifications. Position changes apply immediately and are saved automatically.
motionHelp: Serial matching and replies · Manual connection · Release port on window close
motionRuleHelp: Match complete messages exactly and reply, or send the response manually.
motionEmpty: Create a customer, configure a serial port, then add rules.
motionCustomerHelp: Each customer has independent serial settings and rules. Configure before connecting.
motionFramingHelp: Delimiter framing excludes the delimiter from matching. Fixed length counts bytes. Use idle framing only for protocols delimited by silence.
motionRuleDialogHelp: Exact message matching; text whitespace is preserved. HEX accepts spaces. Manual send uses the response, independently of auto reply.
motionAppend: Append the customer delimiter when sending
motionDeleteHelp: Deletion cannot be undone. Other customers are unaffected.
MOTION_INVALID_PAYLOAD: Enter a rule name and received content. HEX requires complete bytes. Payload limit: 64 KiB. Suffix must be complete HEX bytes; ignored byte count must be 0–256.
MOTION_PERMISSION: Serial port access denied. Check system permissions.
MOTION_PORT_BUSY: The serial port is in use.
MOTION_PORT_MISSING: Serial port missing or not selected. Refresh and select an available port.
MOTION_SERIAL_ERROR: Serial operation failed. Check the device, connection and settings.
MOTION_LIST_FAILED: Could not list serial ports. Retry.
MOTION_DUPLICATE_RULE: A rule with the same received bytes already exists.
MOTION_FRAME_TOO_LARGE: Message exceeded 64 KiB and was discarded.
MOTION_QUEUE_FULL: Send queue full. This send was discarded.
MOTION_WRITE_TIMEOUT: Serial write timed out. Connection stopped.
MOTION_SEND_FAILED: Serial send failed. Check the connection.
motionReceiveSuffix: Remove trailing suffix before matching (HEX, optional)
motionReceiveProcessingHelp: After framing, remove the specified suffix once if present, then ignore 0–256 trailing bytes. Use 0D for CR. This skips checksum bytes without validating CRC. Logs retain the frame before preprocessing.
MOTION_AMBIGUOUS: Multiple rules matched after tail processing. No reply sent; adjust the rules.
tcpHelp: Frame messages using a HEX delimiter: 0A for LF, 0D0A for CRLF. Send each JSON document in a single frame.
tcpSeparator: Text field separator (empty for whole frame)
tcpAppendDelimiter: Append the same delimiter to replies
tcpEndpointHelp: The interface name is the exact match value. For action=getStatus, name the interface getStatus. Names are case-sensitive and must be unique.
tcpResponseHint: TCP replies contain UTF-8 content without HTTP headers or status codes. JSON is compacted without changing string contents. Unmatched, disabled or invalid messages are logged without a reply.
TCP_DUPLICATE_NAME: TCP interface names must be unique.
TCP_REQUEST: TCP message matched and queued for sending
TCP_FIELD_MISSING: TCP interface field is missing or invalid
TCP_INVALID_MESSAGE: Invalid TCP UTF-8 or JSON message
TCP_BACKPRESSURE: TCP outgoing buffer exceeded its limit; connection closed
tcpWrapResponse: Automatically frame replies with length and marker
tcpLengthHelp: The header is fixed-width, zero-padded numeric text. Example: 4 decimal digits and body length: 0016{"action":"get"}#; body is 16 bytes, marker HEX is 23. Unicode characters and UTF-8 bytes differ.
tcpLengthTailHelp: Use HEX for the marker: 23 for #, 0D0A for CRLF. Read the declared body length, then verify the marker. The same marker may appear inside the body. Invalid length or marker closes the connection.
TCP_INVALID_LENGTH: Invalid TCP length header or range; connection closed
TCP_INVALID_END_MARKER: TCP end marker does not match the protocol
TCP_LENGTH_OVERFLOW: Reply length does not fit the header; nothing sent
tcpWrappedHelp: Example: <HH00016>{"action":"get"}<TT>. Prefix <HH, five decimal body-length digits, suffix >, end marker HEX 3C54543E. Whole-frame length includes fixed text. Framed replies use the same wrapper.
TCP_INVALID_HEADER: TCP fixed header marker mismatch; connection closed
